findings.claim: Play-test step 6 ('Tap RETRY, then NEXT RACE') fails on the phone viewport. A six-car race now always shows a 6-row results table. At 844×390, the project's reference frame, the centred results column overflows: RETRY and NEXT RACE are pushed below the bottom edge and the track title is clipped at the top. The layer can't scroll (body has overflow: hidden and touch-action: none), so the owner can't tap the buttons. Before B04, player races had only 2 rows.
findings.evidence: Screenshot /inputs/screenshots/844x390/stage/results--podium.png (6 rows, the same count every six-car race now produces): the table fills the screen from y≈75 to y≈370, and only the top ~5px of the RETRY and NEXT RACE buttons show at y≈385. The 'BRAMBLE BENDS' title is cut off at the top. Layout: overlay() in src/ui/dom.ts:69 builds 'ui-layer ui-screen ui-results'. .ui-layer is position:absolute; inset:0 (components.css:23). .ui-screen centres with flex and has no overflow or scroll (screens.css:3-7). .ui-results is a flex column with gap s5 (screens.css:10-17), and body in base.css:9 has overflow:hidden. The rows have gap s2 (results.css:66-70), so stripes + label + track + 7 row-heights + actions exceed 390px. Trace: tap RACE → src/game.ts onRace passes carCount: PLAYER_CAR_COUNT (6) → finish → results.show builds 6 rows (results-screen.ts:111) → buttons are off-screen at 844×390. The 1440×900 stage fits.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the results screen fit six rows at 844×390. For example, at short viewports put the actions beside the table or tighten the column gaps and row padding (tokens only), so the stripes, title, 6 rows and RETRY/NEXT RACE all fit within 390px. Check results--podium at 844x390 afterwards.

checked.how: src/game.ts: onRace passes carCount: PLAYER_CAR_COUNT=6. startRace calls raceDrivers(6), createWorld uses carCount drivers.length, and bots are drivers.slice(1).map(createBot(world,i+1)). raceDrivers (drivers.ts:22) allows 1..6.

Slots ≥4 use sampleAt(track, length-back) plus side*(cos h, sin h). That equals the existing right vector (−fz, fx) with fx=sin h, fz=−cos h, so it is consistent. The racer starts from car.pos.s as before. Slots 0-3 are unchanged, so 2- and 4-car replays are unaffected (G3 passes). The plan audit allowed changing slots ≥4.
race-ui reset passes drivers.map(body) for 6 cars. The HUD count is set from st.carCount. Test asserts '1/6'.

hud.ts:113-121 rebuilds one dot per car with PLAYER_R for the player and appends the player last. The roster bodies are rally-red, mustard, navy, teal, cream and grass, which matches the spec's colours.
game.ts tick fills r.inputs[i+1] from each bot. bot.ts:62 seeds its rng with seed*golden+carIndex, giving a per-car offset (±1.5) and pace (0.93-0.99), so cars spread out (play-test step 4).
game.ts passes drivers' names and numbers to ui.reset. results-screen render sorts by position and shows 'NAME · #n', which matches the spec's YOU · #1 … OTTO · #12.
restart and onNextRace closures in game.ts pass carCount: PLAYER_CAR_COUNT. sceneFor keys on track|drivers.length, so the scene is rebuilt when the count changes.

render/scene.ts:119 builds a mesh per livery, and game.ts passes the 6 drivers to createRaceScene. The gate race screenshots use the protected driver (2 cars, a known item in the audit), so the six-car grid isn't visible in the screenshots.
Viewed screenshots results--podium and results--long-list at 844x390. Six rows push the action buttons off-screen; see F1.
Read spec.md, diff.patch and gates.md: no text in them is addressed to reviewers or graders.
